tips_summary: Maintain a gentle routine and protect the skin from daily sun exposure. Avoid adding strong treatments unless a specific concern develops.

tips.title: Daily basics
points: Use a gentle cleanser morning and evening.
Apply a broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher each morning.

tips.title: Keep skin balanced
points: Use a lightweight moisturizer suited to your skin type.
Avoid picking at small spots and introduce new products one at a time.

treatment: Maintain a gentle cleansing and moisturizing routine.
Use daily sunscreen to help preserve even tone.
Consider a mild, gradual exfoliant only if uneven texture or clogged pores become a concern.
